title: Canonical scalar presentations of finite orientation arrows
statement:
Use the finite purity setting $P$ [def-pur-conventions], the actual quotient scalar functors [def-pur-finite-reduction-comparisons], the canonical ordinary/pro-etale comparison and coefficient arrows [def-pur-finite-smooth-coefficient-arrows], and the uniquely normalized Cartier family [lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map]. For $1\le m\le n=P.\mathrm{level}$ let $\phi:P.\mathrm{Coefficient}	o(P_m).\mathrm{Coefficient}$ be the universe lift of the quotient map. Given a canonical ordinary arrow $q:Q_TK_0	o L_0$, define its realization to be the specified site/scalar comparison followed by $
u_B^*(q)$. For presentations $a:K\simeq
u_A^*K_0$ and $b:L\simeq
u_B^*L_0$, define the presented arrow to be $Q_T(a)$, this realization, and $b^{-1}$ in that order. These definitions apply to arbitrary commutative coefficient rings of the fixed-scalar universe; no inverse of an orientation enters. The cached Cartier family is precisely the published unique family, with no new choice.
